correctness.rationale: For b>0, q=alpha+beta>0 and delta=(beta-alpha)/q∈(-1,1), the oscillator drift is Hurwitz and independent Gaussian noise adds no centered cumulant of order three. Center Y=X-delta/b and telegraph S=sigma-delta. The algebraic two-state identity S²=(1-delta²)-2delta S and Markov generator produce the stated coupled linear recurrences for M_ij and N_ij. Reconstructed degree-one, degree-two and degree-three balance, and independently solved exact rational linear systems at b=2,q=1,delta=1/3,T=1/2; obtained (E Y³,E Y²V,E YV²,E V³)=(-19/297,0,-1/33,2/297), precisely the pinned formulas. Their positive denominator H and strictly positive factors imply position/mixed fixed signs and unique nonzero-bias velocity skew zero at 3b-2(q+1)=0; temperature never enters the third cumulant. Since 2(q+1)/3>2/3>1/4, the threshold is underdamped. Symmetric delta=0 is correctly excluded from a strict skew-sign reversal.
